docs.title: MetalCompat — GPU Runtime (v0.2.0)
docs.desc: Implements SPEC §5: real Metal workloads on the real Apple GPU. Nothing here invents hardware; every kernel and pass must be expressible in public MSL/MTL.

docs.title: MetalCompat — CPU Runtime (v0.2.0)
docs.desc: Implements SPEC §4 on the current repository shape. Do not emulate a CPU (SPEC D-004); this module prepares, validates, schedules, and submits.
